# Temple Scroll Column 43 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 43 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**43:1** And every creature that walks on its paws among all creatures that go on all fours — they are unclean to you.

**43:2** Whoever touches their carcass shall be unclean until evening.

**43:3** And whoever carries their carcass shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening; they are unclean to you.

**43:4** These are the ones that are unclean to you among the swarming things that swarm upon the earth: the weasel and the mouse and the great lizard according to its kind.

**43:5** The gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the sand lizard, and the chameleon.

**43:6** Anyone who touches their carcass shall be unclean until evening; whoever carries their carcass shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening.

**43:7** Anything upon which any of them falls when dead shall be unclean — whether a vessel of wood or a garment or a skin or a sack.

**43:8** Any vessel with which work is done shall be put into water and be unclean until evening; then it shall be clean.

**43:9** Every earthen vessel into which any of them falls — whatever is in it shall be unclean, and you shall break it.

**43:10** Any food that may be eaten upon which water comes shall be unclean; and any liquid that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

**43:11** Every swarming creature that swarms upon the earth — it is detestable; it shall not be eaten.

**43:12** Whatever goes on its belly and whatever goes on all fours and whatever has many feet among all swarming creatures that swarm upon the earth — you shall not eat them, for they are detestable.

**43:13** You shall not make yourselves detestable with any swarming creature that swarms, and you shall not make yourselves unclean with them so as to be defiled by them.

**43:14** For I am the LORD your God; you shall sanctify yourselves and be holy, for I am holy.

**43:15** You shall not defile yourselves with any swarming creature that moves upon the earth.

**43:16** For I am the LORD who brought you up from the land of Egypt to be your God; and you shall be holy, for I am holy.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows EMET with "monitor lizard" adopted from LOGOS/PNEUMA in v. 5 over EMET's "land crocodile" — modern zoological consensus favors this identification. "Detestable" preferred over LOGOS's "abomination" and PNEUMA's "disgusting" for sheqetz. "Sanctify" retained over LOGOS's "consecrate" per project convention.*
